$comment: Verification schemes (bipe ADR 0272; docs/badge-attestation.md, docs/signed-lists.md). A scheme is one proof rail or registry in one country. class: person or org. assurance: person is bank or state, org is registry+control. alias: the older badge level of this scheme; an alias badge counts as this scheme. names: the label per locale. Each scheme belongs to one region in registries/regions.json. The signed issuer registry carries the schemes of every region, so a new country needs no app release. zz is reserved for test vectors and never appears here.
